column2: Remove the frozen grated coconut from the freezer and let it thaw completely
Soak the mung dal for 1 hr and then drain the excess water, keep aside in a large mixing bowl
Grate the carrots in the food processor and mix with the soaked dal
Squeeze the lemon juice and keep aside
Clean and finely chop cilantro.  Finely chop green chillies and curry leaves and keep aside
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, once they sputter add urad dal, hing .  When ulad dal is golden add curry leaves and green chillies
Add the coconut, salt, lemon juice, cilantro.   Toss and mix evenly and serve
